text:
incident-bot: ALERT: eval-gate triggered -> safety regression detected on prod model variant `redwood-open-3b-quant` (rule: profanity-increase > 2.5x). Pager fired to on-call.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-7348 created and routed to SRE OnCall. Link: https://pd.company/pd-incidents/PD-7348 :rotating_light:
raj.kumar: acked PD-7348 — I'm on it. Starting triage. @maya @alex FYI this looks like an eval gate trip, not infra.
maya: Thanks Raj. Quick context: the eval gate compared the last deploy (2026-03-14-09:12) to baseline. Safety metric 'profanity_rate' jumped from 0.04% -> 0.11% on the customer sample set. Also slight output drift on prompts that use temperature=0.8.
alex: Noted. Which customers are impacted? Any high-traffic routes? :thinking_face:
ml-eval-bot: EVAL SUMMARY: 2026-03-14 09:45
- model: redwood-open-3b-quant@v2026-03-14-09:12
- gate: safety.strike.profanity
- sample size: 1,200 requests
- failure rate: 12/1,200 -> 1.0% absolute, 2.75x relative
- top failing prompt templates: freeform-chat, product-description
- flagged tokens: profanity, sexual-content

raj.kumar: Impact assessment: this variant is live in hosted production in region-us-west with 18% of traffic (canary rollout). A few small customers on Dedicated also got pinned to this variant (2 customers). No DB or infra errors observed.
maya: Confirmed seeing increased customer complaints in #support — 3 tickets so far flagged for offensive outputs (tier2). I'll draft a customers-impacted list and notify CS.
taylor: Oncall SRE checklist:
1) confirm it's model-quality, not prompt injection or user-side input
2) stop canary rollouts / pause traffic to variant
3) fallback to last-known-good variant
4) collect logs + KV caches for ML team

alex: Can we flip traffic immediately? What endpoints control routing? I have a small script to patch rollout percentages.
raj.kumar: Yes. Run this to switch traffic to fallback `redwood-open-3b-quant@v2026-03-13-21:00` and set suspect variant to 0%.

```
# curl example to update rollout
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/rollouts/patch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-3b-quant","variants":{"v2026-03-14-09:12":0, "v2026-03-13-21:00":100}}'
```

pagerduty: PD-7348 Acked by raj.kumar at 09:52. Escalation paused.
raj.kumar: Executed rollback patch at 09:54. Canary variant -> 0%, baseline variant -> 100%. Logs: rollout-api returned 200. Observability: token-level logs show traffic flip completed; 95th latency unchanged.
maya: CS note: sending templated apology + mitigation email to 2 dedicated customers now. Draft: "We detected an elevated rate of unsafe outputs from a recently deployed model variant. We've rolled back to the previous variant and are investigating."
alex: Running quick diff on prompt-responses for the failing templates. Early look: the new quant params appear to change tokenization around certain slurs leading to false positives on filtering heuristics.
ml-eval-bot: Additional checks: quantization profile mismatch flagged for layernorm-fusion, recommending re-quantize with per-channel scaling. Score: low->medium risk.
sre-oncall: Good rollback. Next steps for SRE: retain pod logs (+KV cache snapshots) for 72 hours, increase debug logging for inference route /v1/chat for 30 mins, and ensure autoscaling is not triggered by the surge in logging.
raj.kumar: Creating incident ticket in JIRA: REDWOOD-INC-2026-7348. Assigning to @alex (ml infra) and @maya (ml-eval). I'll own the incident until handoff.
alex: I'll dig into the quantization artifact. If it's a packaging issue in the build pipeline, we should block the pipeline for this model family until signoff. Also add a short-term rule to eval-gate to block canary >0% on any quant rebuilds.
maya: I'll run more focused evals on the customer prompt corpus + safety heuristics. If we can pinpoint the tokenization hit list we can patch the filter or revert the quantization change.
raj.kumar: Customer impact: 2 dedicated customers received outputs (CS engaged, customers temporarily paused traffic). Hosted API: estimated <=0.5% of total users saw the issue because canary was at 18% for a small subset of prompt shapes. No public incident declared yet. Suggest we update status page to "investigating" until we confirm all routes stable.
ml-eval-bot: Added evidence bundles to the incident ticket: logs, sample outputs, evaluation diff CSV (s3://eval-bundles/PD-7348/). Please download before 72h retention.
alex: Found build diff: commit a1b2c3 changed tokenization mapping for byte pair ID 4827. Reverting that change in a hotfix branch now.
raj.kumar: Handoff plan: if root cause is model build, handoff to ML infra + ML-eval. If root cause is eval filter, handoff to SRE + Product. For now, owner = raj.kumar; next update in 30m.
maya: Noting retrospective actions: add automated rollback when safety metric delta > 2x AND canary > 10%. Current canary policy allowed 18% which is above that. We should tighten thresholds.
alex: Pushing hotfix and triggering a dry-run eval against the sample set. Will update when results are in.
raj.kumar: Good work all. Quick checklist for post-incident:
- [ ] Confirm rollback stability for 2h
- [ ] CS customer follow-up complete
- [ ] Postmortem + RCA in 72h
- [ ] Improve eval-gate config + threshold change

maya: interim status: mitigated (rollback done), customer mitigation in progress, root cause investigation ongoing. I'll post a summary to #incidents in 30m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident PD-7348: status -> acknowledged by raj.kumar; state -> mitigated (customer impact reduced).
